title: Figs. 16-17: GT-4 crew portraits, James A. McDivitt and Edward H. White II
description: Two official astronaut portrait photographs from the "ASTRONAUTS" section of NASA document M-913-65-04: Fig. 16 shows James A. McDivitt in a suit and tie, and Fig. 17 shows Edward H. White II in a pressure suit with a NASA patch. The text identifies them as Command Pilot and Pilot for the GT-4 mission and gives McDivitt's biography.
